name: browser-use
headline: cclsp Claude Code LSP integration tool
short_description: Enhance Claude Code with LSP integration for better code completion, error detection, and refactoring. Works outside IDEs, benefiting developers and operations teams. Integrates with MCP servers for improved workflows.
author: ktnyt

sections.overview:
CCLSP is an MCP server that connects Language Server Protocol (LSP) capabilities to Claude Code, providing developers with advanced code intelligence features. It supports find_definition, find_references, and symbol renaming across TypeScript, Python, Go, and 30+ other languages. The skill includes atomic file editing with backup and rollback support for safe refactoring operations. Developers can use it to enhance code completion, error detection, and refactoring without relying on traditional IDEs. Operations teams benefit from workspace-level code analysis and multi-file synchronization with LSP servers.
Quickly navigate to function definitions in large codebases using AI assistance.
Automatically find all references to a variable or function across multiple files.
Rename variables or functions safely across an entire project with minimal risk.
Integrate LSP capabilities into non-IDE environments for enhanced coding workflows.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ktnyt/cclsp`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
